confirm.clearQueueDesc: This clears the play queue and keeps only the current track.
confirm.clearRecentDesc: This deletes all recently played records. It cannot be undone.
confirm.clearDownloadsDesc: This removes all finished download records.
confirm.deletePlaylistDesc: “{{name}}” will be deleted. This cannot be undone.
confirm.uninstallPluginDesc: “{{name}}” will be uninstalled and no longer used for merging or fallback.
confirm.compatDesc: “{{name}}” will only be allowed to reach: {{hosts}}. Every other host is rejected, so the plugin may fail if it needs another one; restoring compatibility mode requires importing it again.
confirm.removeLocalDesc: “{{name}}” will be removed from the library. The file on disk is kept.
confirm.purgeImportedDesc: {{count}} imported copy/copies will be removed from the library and deleted from disk. Music you scanned yourself is untouched (so are the original files).
confirm.removeDownloadDesc: The download record for “{{name}}” will be removed.
confirm.removeSubscriptionDesc: Subscription “{{name}}” and its cached index will be removed; installed plugins are unaffected.
confirm.removePetDesc: “{{name}}”, its bond record and its assets will be removed. This cannot be undone.
confirm.dataDirMoveDesc: Data will be copied to {{path}} and used after a restart; the old folder is kept (not deleted automatically).

skin.exportedToFile: Exported “{{name}}” and revealed it in the file manager
skin.exportCopied: Copied the skin JSON for “{{name}}” to the clipboard
skin.exportCopyFailed: Copy failed — the skin JSON was filled into the import panel, please copy it manually
skin.importRejected: Skin uses token keys that are not allowed: {{keys}}
skin.jsonPlaceholder: Paste the contents of a .gently-skin.json here (same rule as plugins: you bring the source)
skin.pathHint: Paste a path directly, or pick a file with the picker. Validation and install happen in the local core.
skin.packageNoJson: No skin JSON in the package: pick skin.json (or any .json) and import again.
skin.packageAmbiguous: More than one JSON was selected: pick only the theme's own JSON (naming it skin.json is recommended).
skin.packageImported: Imported theme “{{name}}” and applied the background bundled with it ({{background}}).

player.failureInterrupted: Playback was interrupted by the system (tap play to continue)

hot.emptyHint: Play a few songs, favorite some albums, or scan your local music — this page ranks by your taste
hot.discoverSubtitle: Record shelf: each sleeve stands upright on the shelf — focus one to hear the chorus
hot.discoverEmpty: Nothing to display yet — listen to a few songs, or connect a source
hot.discoverPickHint: Pick a sleeve from the shelf, or click the list on the right

local.title: Local Music
local.subtitle: {{count}} songs
local.empty: No local music yet — open "Scan local folders" above and scan a folder
local.scanHint: One folder per line. Only audio extensions (mp3/flac/m4a/m4b/m4r/m4s/mp4/aac/ogg/oga/opus/wav) are indexed; files whose size is unchanged are not re-read; files without readable tags are still indexed (title falls back to the file name). On desktop paste a folder path; on a phone there is no absolute path to paste — use Import from this phone above.
local.scanResult: Last scan: {{scanned}} files, {{added}} added, {{updated}} updated, {{removed}} removed, {{skipped}} skipped, {{unreadable}} unreadable, {{ignored}} non-audio
local.scanNeedsDesktop: Scanning local folders needs the desktop app (the browser preview shows sample data).
local.scanBriefIdle: Expand to enter folders and scan
local.scanBriefIdleMobile: Use Import from this phone to add songs
local.importHint: Pick audio files with the system picker; they are copied into this app (deleting the originals later is fine).
local.importedPartial: Imported {{imported}} file(s), {{failed}} could not be read
local.cleanedImported: Removed {{count}} track(s) and their copies inside the app
local.importEmpty: None of the selected files were readable audio
local.importSkippedOnly: None of the {{count}} selected file(s) were audio (the hint below lists the recognised extensions)
local.importFailed: Could not open the file picker

plugin.coreHint: Plugins are imported by you on this machine; this app ships and recommends no online sources.
plugin.browserNotice: Previewing in a browser: plugin management needs the desktop app (this page shows mock data).
plugin.pathHint: Paste a path: a .js file, a folder containing plugin.json, or a .zip (one extra folder inside the archive is fine). There is no “Browse…” button — a native file picker needs an extra desktop plugin that is not in the current dependency set.
plugin.pastePlaceholder: Paste the .js plugin here (it should start with // @id …)
plugin.compatLabel: Import in compatibility mode (MusicFree / LX ecosystem plugins)
plugin.compatHint: For CommonJS plugins without header metadata. Compatibility mode may reach any public host and is weaker than the normal plugin ABI; off by default.
plugin.compatWarning: Compatibility mode: this plugin may reach any public host (loopback and private networks are still blocked), is not limited to a host allowlist, and is weaker than the normal plugin ABI.
plugin.compatNoHosts: No hosts observed yet: use the plugin once (search or play), then come back to restrict it.
plugin.consent: I have reviewed the permissions and origin above, and I confirm I may access the content this plugin provides.
plugin.permissionNetwork: Network access (only the hosts the plugin declares)
plugin.permissionNetworkCompat: Network access (compatibility mode has no host allowlist: any public host)
plugin.replaces: This replaces the installed plugin with the same id
plugin.installedEmpty: No plugins imported yet — the app ships no built-in sources; import one yourself.
plugin.disclaimer: Plugins are provided by third parties and are unrelated to this software; please make sure you may access their content.
plugin.needSource: Please provide the plugin content or URL first
plugin.qrTitle: Sign in with a QR code
plugin.qrHint: Scan it with the app on your phone. The session is stored only in the local credential store; nothing goes through a server.
plugin.qrExpired: The QR code expired. Generate a new one.
plugin.qrNoCore: QR sign-in needs the local core (desktop app).
plugin.qrConfirmed: Signed in: the session was written to this machine's credential store; you can close this panel.
plugin.qrConfigured: This plugin already has a credential; scanning again replaces it with the new session.
plugin.qrRisk: Heads-up: some sources treat third-party client sign-in as risky (some have started demanding a password change, then freezing the account). If you would rather not risk it, paste a cookie below instead — same effect, no sign-in risk control.
plugin.webLoginTitle: Sign in inside a window (session read automatically)
plugin.webLoginHint: Opens the source's own sign-in page. Once you are signed in there (QR or password), the app writes this window's session into the local credential store — no devtools, no copy-paste.
plugin.webLoginHost: Sign-in page host: {{host}} (declared by the plugin manifest; the app hardcodes no address)
plugin.webLoginWaiting: Waiting for you to sign in (close the window to cancel)…
plugin.webLoginDone: Signed in: the session was written to this machine's credential store.
plugin.webLoginCanceled: No session was captured (window closed or timed out); credentials left untouched.
plugin.credentialGuide: Where the value comes from is up to the plugin: usually you sign in on that site in a browser first, then copy the cookie / token it asks for. The app never fetches it for you and never sends it anywhere; save it here and the source favorites can use it.
plugin.oauthTitle: Third-party sign-in (after install, your browser opens that domain's consent page)
plugin.authTitle: Third-party sign-in (OAuth 2.0, endpoints declared by this plugin)
plugin.authSignOutConfirmDesc: Deletes the token stored on this machine; features that need sign-in (such as favorites) stop working immediately.
plugin.authWaiting: Waiting for the browser to finish…
plugin.authFailed: Authorization did not complete (see the log for details); you can try again
plugin.authEndpointHint: The consent page opens in your system browser; its address comes from this plugin's manifest — the app ships no third-party addresses of its own, so a different source means different endpoints.
plugin.authStoredHint: The token is stored only in the system credential manager; it never reaches the UI, the database or the logs.
plugin.authRestartHint: The system credential store is unavailable, so the token falls back to in-process storage — you will need to authorize again after a restart.
plugin.authNoPkceHint: This plugin does not use PKCE: a public client is more exposed if the authorization code is intercepted. Worth reporting to the plugin author.
plugin.authDesktopOnly: Authorization needs the local core of the desktop build (unavailable in browser preview).
plugin.credentialNone: This plugin declares no credential fields
plugin.credentialEmpty: Fill in at least one credential first
plugin.credentialStoredHint: Credentials go into the system credential manager (not the app database or logs) and survive restarts; they are only handed to the plugin that declared each key.
plugin.credentialRestartHint: The system credential store is unavailable, so credentials fall back to in-process storage — you will need to re-enter them after a restart (see the diagnostics card in Settings).
plugin.configHint: A JSON object; current revision {{revision}} (a save conflicts if it changed elsewhere — reload to get the latest)
plugin.configObjectOnly: Config must be a JSON object
plugin.configConflict: Config changed elsewhere — reload before saving
plugin.subscriptionHint: A subscription is a repository index (repository.json): enter the address once, then pick plugins from it. The app ships no subscription addresses and never adds one for you.
plugin.subscriptionAdded: Subscription added (a failed first fetch shows the reason; the old index is kept)
plugin.catalogEmpty: No installable entries yet (refresh the index first)
plugin.title: Plugins
plugin.subtitle: Music sources are plugins — {{count}} installed
plugin.priorityHint: Higher in the list wins: playback tries sources in this order and falls back automatically.
plugin.installDone: "{{name}}" imported — you can search and play right away (no restart needed).

favorites.subtitle: {{count}} songs
favorites.sourceSubtitle: Favorites in a source account (if the source supports it)
favorites.sourceEmpty: This source returned no favorite songs
favorites.sourceHint: Source favorites come from a plugin (sign-in is up to that source). They are not cached locally: each visit fetches them again.
favorites.noSourceFavorites: No enabled source provides favorites (a plugin must implement getFavorites and be signed in).
favorites.collectionMore: {{count}} more not listed — keep typing to narrow down

search.subtitle: {{count}} songs for “{{keyword}}”
search.hint: Type a keyword to start searching
search.noSource: No source is installed, so there is nothing to search

collection.title: Album / playlist
collection.notFound: Not found, or this source does not provide it

nowPlaying.searchLyricsHint: Looks for lyrics across your installed sources and shows which source and track each result belongs to. Pick one to replace the current lyrics.
nowPlaying.searchLyricsEmpty: No lyrics found — try another keyword.
nowPlaying.searchLyricsNoCore: Searching lyrics needs the desktop core; the browser preview only shows the UI.
nowPlaying.searchLyricsTimedOut: {{count}} sources timed out; results may be incomplete
nowPlaying.lyricsOffsetHint: If the lyrics run early or late, fine-tune by 0.1 s first, then 0.5 s; remembered per track.
nowPlaying.syncKeys: ← / → fine-tune 0.1 s, hold Shift for 0.5 s
nowPlaying.sourceManual: You picked these lyrics by hand — remembered for this track next time.
nowPlaying.sourceAutoHint: Using this track's own source; search below to switch.

background.title: Dynamic background
background.hint: Video stays on this machine and is never uploaded. mp4 / webm / m4v are supported. Presets only store display options; proprietary wallpaper packages are not parsed.
background.webHint: Static single-file wallpapers support HTML/CSS and inlined data:/blob: assets only. Scripts never run and external CSS/JS/images are not loaded.
background.webConfirmDesc: "{{name}}" will be loaded as static HTML/CSS: scripts do not run and external resources are not loaded. Still, only import files you trust. Continue?
background.errorWebTooLarge: The web page exceeds the limit ({{mb}} MB).
background.errorWebType: Only single-file HTML / XHTML is supported.
background.missing: The background data is missing (site data may have been cleared). Import it again.
background.reducedMotionHint: The background is off by default when the system has Reduce Motion enabled. Choose "Play anyway" for a dynamic wallpaper; other system animations are unaffected.
background.reducedMotion: The system has Reduce Motion enabled, so the background is off. Choose "Play anyway" above to override it.
background.contentOpacityHint: Adjusts only the card/shell background alpha; text and icons stay opaque. Applies while a background is active.
background.contentBlurHint: Adjusts only the card/shell backdrop blur; text stays sharp. 0 disables it (less GPU work).
background.drawerOpacityHint: Adjusts menus, panels and search suggestions independently from cards; text and icons stay opaque.
background.drawerBlurHint: Adjusts only the drawer/popover backdrop blur. 0 disables it (less GPU work).
background.presetExportHint: The exported JSON is placed in the textarea below for copying. Import uses the same textarea.
background.presetExported: Current preset JSON generated; copy it below.
background.presetEmpty: No presets yet. Adjust the options and save one.
background.presetImportHint: Paste JSON exported by an external wallpaper tool. Only known options are mapped; unknown keys are kept and reported.
background.presetNoMapped: No mappable display options were found.
background.presetDeleteDesc: Delete "{{name}}"? The current background is unchanged.
background.resetDesc: Removes the current imported video and resets display options. Named presets are kept.
background.errorUnsupported: This environment does not support local video storage.
background.errorTooLarge: The file exceeds the limit ({{mb}} MB).
background.errorType: Only mp4 / webm / m4v / ogg videos are supported.
background.errorStorage: Writing to local storage failed (possibly out of space).
background.assistantHint: Only the folder you pick is read — nothing is uploaded or fetched. Scripts and external assets are removed; local images/CSS that can be inlined become data URIs.

assistantWarn.css-import-removed: CSS @import was removed (static single-file mode does not fetch styles).
assistantWarn.css-asset-missing: A CSS asset was missing; it was replaced with an empty resource.
assistantWarn.external-asset-removed: An external asset reference was removed.
assistantWarn.asset-missing: An HTML asset was missing; the reference was removed.
assistantWarn.srcset-simplified: srcset was simplified to the primary image.

background.assistantImported: The built web page is now the background.
background.assistantConfirmDesc: "{{name}}" will become the background; scripts will not run and external assets were removed. Continue?
background.assistantErrorInputLarge: The folder is too large (maximum {{mb}} MB).
background.assistantErrorNoHtml: No HTML file found in the folder.
background.assistantErrorOutputLarge: The built page exceeds the limit ({{mb}} MB); compress images or reduce assets.
background.assistantErrorBuild: Build failed; check the folder structure.
background.assistantVideoHint: Export mp4/webm from WE or another tool, then use “Import video” above. gently does not transcode; 4K/high-bitrate files cost more.
background.assistantSceneHint: gently does not parse .pkg/.tex. Export or record it in WE, convert to mp4/webm, then use “Import video” above.
background.assistantPresetHint: Keep using the text box in the background card above: only playbackrate/alignment/opacity/blur are mapped; other keys are reported as unmapped.

setting.title: Settings
setting.subtitle: Appearance, language and data source
setting.confirmHint: When off, delete / clear / uninstall actions run immediately
setting.discoverPreviewHint: When on, focusing a sleeve on Discover plays 20 seconds at low volume without touching the main player. The start point is an estimate (mid-song): sources provide no chorus timestamps. Nothing plays when no playable address or duration is available.
setting.petHint: When on, the pet lives in its own always-on-top window (separate from the app, survives minimizing it): it looks at your cursor and clicks pass through everywhere except its body. Left click to pet, right click to feed. It runs on its own engine and database, independent of the music core. Off by default.
setting.petNeedsDesktop: The pet needs the desktop core; the browser preview has no pet engine, so it is unavailable.
setting.petNone: No pets yet (turning the switch on installs a built-in one)
setting.petCount: {{count}} total (only one is shown at a time)
setting.petLockHint: When on, clicks pass through the pet window; the pet cannot be clicked or dragged — unlock only here.
setting.petDebugNoProbe: not read yet (press Probe one frame to retry)
setting.petDebugHint: Read-only info from three layers: core data, host window, last rendered frame. Probing calls pet.tick once with dtMs = 0 and does not advance the animation.
setting.petRoamHint: When on, the pet walks to a different spot along the bottom of the window every 10–40 seconds (using runLeft / runRight); it pauses while your cursor is on it.
setting.petDropHint: Drop pet.json and spritesheet.webp here (or paste the JSON and pick the atlas below)
setting.petImportTitle: Pet package (pet.json + optional atlas; Codex Pet v1 also works)
setting.petSpecPlaceholder: Paste pet.json here (our format, or Codex Pet v1: {id, displayName, spritesheetPath})
setting.petAtlasLabel: Choose an atlas image (png / webp, optional)
setting.petAtlasHint: Atlas is optional: a horizontal frame strip whose frame count comes from pet.json animations. Without an atlas the renderer draws a procedural pet.
setting.lyricsLock: Lock the lyrics window (clicks pass through)
setting.lyricsLockHint: When locked, mouse clicks go through the lyrics bar to the window below, so it never gets in the way. You can only unlock it here — a locked bar cannot receive clicks, including its own buttons.
setting.lyricsSweepHint: When on, the current line lights up from left to right. The lyrics window interpolates the position itself; the main window syncs timing once per second.
setting.diagUnavailableHint: The browser preview uses mock data; the desktop build serves the library, playback and local files from the local core
setting.diagCredentialsOs: Using the system credential store (survives restarts)
setting.diagCredentialsMemory: Fell back to in-process storage: re-enter after a restart
setting.downloadDirPlaceholder: Leave empty for the default folder
setting.downloadDirHint: Empty = the downloads folder under the data directory. A custom folder must already exist; the core rejects missing folders with a clear reason.
setting.downloadDirMobileHint: Downloads and cache live in the app's private storage (system-managed) and are removed when you uninstall the app.
setting.downloadConcurrentHint: Extra tracks wait in a queue instead of competing for bandwidth.
setting.whenDownloadQualityIsMissing: When the preferred quality is unavailable
setting.cacheHint: Only tracks you played and lyrics you used are cached; offline playback prefers the local cache. Oldest entries are removed when the limit is exceeded.
setting.cacheLimitHint: When the cache exceeds this limit the core evicts the least recently played tracks. Lowering it takes effect immediately. Only tracks you have played are cached — the disk is never pre-filled.
setting.cacheLimitSaved: Size limit updated (and the cache was trimmed to it)
setting.cacheClearDesc: The cache is rebuilt on demand (played songs need to be played online again to be cached); downloaded files are not affected.
setting.cacheUnavailable: Cache management needs the desktop core; the browser preview has no local cache.
setting.dataDirHint: Database, plugins, skins, downloads and cache all live in this folder. It defaults to your user profile — move it to another drive here.
setting.dataDirMobileHint: Database, plugins, skins, downloads and cache live in the app's private storage, which the system manages; it cannot be moved inside the app and is removed when you uninstall it.
setting.dataDirSourcePointer: Moved location (remembered by a pointer file)
setting.dataDirSourceOverride: Set by the GENTLY_DATA_DIR environment variable
setting.dataDirPortableHint: This is a portable build: data defaults to the data folder next to the executable. Drop an empty portable.txt beside the exe to enable it.
setting.dataDirMoveHint: Moving copies the data to the new folder and remembers it; it takes effect after a restart. The old folder is kept — delete it yourself once you are sure.
setting.dataDirNeedTarget: Enter a target folder first (absolute path, e.g. D:/gently-data)
setting.dataDirMoved: Copied {{files}} files ({{size}}) to {{path}} — effective after a restart.
setting.dataDirKept: The old folder {{path}} was not deleted.
setting.dataDirUnavailable: Moving the data folder needs the desktop core; the browser preview has no data folder to move.
